researcher v1.5.0 live-test: MCP gateway in this session shows 0/0 servers (managed Exa MCP not connected here); answered via live official sources instead: exa.ai/docs/reference/exa-mcp (modified 2026-08-27) + exa-labs/exa-mcp-server README. 4 tools confirmed.


### researcher · muse-spark-1.3-contributor · [turn 13 · WORKING]

## Summary
Exa MCP server currently exposes 4 tools. Ground truth in bead confirmed against live official sources. No change.

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `web_search_exa` | Default. Fast semantic web search, returns clean ready-to-use content/snippets. Everyday lookups. |
| `web_fetch_exa` | Default. Full page content extraction as clean markdown from one or more URLs. Follows search. |
| `web_search_advanced_exa` | Opt-in via `?tools=`. Full Search API: category/domain filters, date ranges, text constraints, geo, query expansion, summaries, highlights, freshness, subpage crawling. Targeted retrieval. |
| `agent_run` | Opt-in via `?tools=`, requires auth (OAuth/API key, usage-based). Multi-step Exa Agent research: list-building, enrichment, structured output (`outputSchema`), `dataSources` (Exa Connect, max 5), `effort` levels, long-run polling (`runId`), continuation (`previousRunId`). |

Enablement: hosted URL `https://mcp.exa.ai/mcp` serves defaults; `?tools=` *replaces* defaults, so list all wanted tools explicitly.

## Status
- Live-test path blocked in this session: MCP gateway reports 0/0 servers, 0 tools — managed Exa MCP not connected here, so no in-protocol `tools/list` introspection possible.
- Research question answered instead via live official sources (docs + repo README, both current).

## Changes
- Files changed: none (research-only, no source edits).
- Bead: claim already held by `researcher/8b962f`; appended progress note; close rejected (assignee mismatch) — left open for owner/orchestrator to close.

## Verification
- `https://exa.ai/docs/reference/exa-mcp` (page footer: Last modified August 27, 2026): Available Tools table lists exactly `web_search_exa`, `web_fetch_exa` (default) + `agent_run`, `web_search_advanced_exa` (opt-in); `agent_run` auth/long-run/`previousRunId`/`dataSources`/`effort` semantics read from same page.
- `https://github.com/exa-labs/exa-mcp-server` README (read live 2026-09-09): identical 4-tool table + `?tools=` replace-defaults semantics + auth notes. Matches docs.
- Discovery via `ddgs`; pages read via `agent-browser` (text body). MCP gateway status checked via `mcp({})` → 0/0.

## Risks
- Marketing pages (`exa.ai/mcp`) mention "code search, company research" — these are capabilities *behind* search/agent tools, not separate MCP tool names. No `code_search`/`company_research` tool in official table or README. Rerun after unblock should assert exact `tools/list` names.
- Exa Connect surfaces as `agent_run.dataSources`, not standalone MCP tools, per current docs. Future versions may add Connect tools; pin conclusion to docs date 2026-08-27.
- ddgs result noted a third-party mirror claiming hosted server ships "two tools" — stale/partial (defaults only), superseded by official 4-tool table.

## Follow-ups
- Rerun after unblock: connect managed Exa MCP, call live `tools/list`, assert set equals these 4 names; assert `pi_session_id` set and state != failed (per live-probe-activation memory).
- Owner to `bd close unitAI-9tawb`.
